compute_f_score: compute the F-score between a ground truth point cloud and a reconstructed mesh using multiple thresholds
average_3d_error: compute the average 3D error between two point clouds using nearest neighbor distances
sample_trimesh_points: sample a specified number of points uniformly from a trimesh surface
start_timing: start a GPU or CPU timer and return start and end event objects for later use
end_timing: end a GPU or CPU timer and return the elapsed time in milliseconds
